```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(igraph)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

```

```{r params}
# ── Cluster column ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CLUS_COL    <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1"

# ── Edge thresholds ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
GLOBAL_THR  <- 0.10   # minimum global PAGA weight to include an edge
COND_THR    <- 0.10   # minimum per-condition weight to show edge in per-condition panels

# ── Clusters to drop ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS  <- c()    # cluster IDs to drop regardless of size
MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE  <- 0L    # drop clusters with fewer cells than this (0 = keep all)

# ── Conditions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
COND_ORDER <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")
COND_PAL   <- c(WT = "#888888", "mCh-" = "#2a9d8f", "mCh+" = "#e76f51")

# ── File paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
GLOBAL_EDGES_CSV <- file.path(
  "output/objects/paga/paga_edges_sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.csv")
COND_EDGES_CSV   <- file.path(
  "output/objects/paga_conditions/paga_edge_comparison_sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.csv")

# ── Plot aesthetics ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NODE_MAX_SIZE  <- 12    # largest node diameter (pt); area ∝ sqrt(n_cells)
EDGE_MAX_WIDTH <-  3    # widest edge (pt); width ∝ connectivity weight
BG_ALPHA       <-  0.25 # opacity of grey background cells
BG_SIZE        <-  0.3  # point size of background cells
FG_SIZE        <-  0.5  # point size of foreground cells
```

---

# 1 · Load data

```{r load-meta}
tar_load(anno_meta_hsc)

# Cell-level metadata: cluster, condition, UMAP coords
meta <- anno_meta_hsc %>%
  rename(cell_id = 1) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = as.character(.data[[CLUS_COL]]),
    condition = case_when(
      grepl("WT",     sample.name) ~ "WT",
      grepl("mCh-",  sample.name) ~ "mCh-",
      grepl("mCh\\+", sample.name) ~ "mCh+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!cluster %in% EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS, !is.na(condition)) %>%
  select(cell_id, UMAP1, UMAP2, cluster, condition, sample.name)

rm(anno_meta_hsc); gc()

cat("Cells after filter:", nrow(meta), "\n")
cat("Clusters:", paste(sort(unique(meta$cluster)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Conditions:", paste(sort(unique(meta$condition)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r load-edges}
global_edges <- read_csv(GLOBAL_EDGES_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(c(cluster_A, cluster_B), as.character)) %>%
  filter(!cluster_A %in% EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS,
         !cluster_B %in% EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS,
         weight >= GLOBAL_THR)

cond_edges_raw <- read_csv(COND_EDGES_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Parse "A-B" pair column → cluster_A, cluster_B
# Pairs are stored as "A-B" with A < B numerically (both non-negative)
cond_edges <- cond_edges_raw %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_A = str_extract(pair, "^[^-]+"),
    cluster_B = str_extract(pair, "[^-]+$")
  ) %>%
  filter(!cluster_A %in% EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS,
         !cluster_B %in% EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS) %>%
  rename(wt = WT, mchneg = `mCh-`, mchpos = `mCh+`) %>%
  select(cluster_A, cluster_B, wt, mchneg, mchpos, max_weight)

cat("Global edges (≥ threshold):", nrow(global_edges), "\n")
cat("Condition-specific edge pairs:", nrow(cond_edges), "\n")
```

# 2 · Cluster layout and sizes

```{r cluster-attrs}
# UMAP centroid per cluster
centroids <- meta %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(x = mean(UMAP1), y = mean(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")

# Cell counts — total and per condition
cluster_total <- meta %>% count(cluster, name = "n_cells")

# Drop clusters below minimum size threshold
if (MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE > 0L) {
  small_clusters <- cluster_total %>%
    filter(n_cells < MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE) %>%
    pull(cluster)
  if (length(small_clusters) > 0) {
    cat("Dropping", length(small_clusters),
        "cluster(s) with < MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE =", MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE, "cells:",
        paste(sort(small_clusters), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    meta          <- meta %>% filter(!cluster %in% small_clusters)
    cluster_total <- meta %>% count(cluster, name = "n_cells")
    centroids     <- meta %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>%
      summarise(x = mean(UMAP1), y = mean(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")
  }
}

cluster_cond <- meta %>%
  count(cluster, condition) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = n, values_fill = 0L)

node_attrs <- centroids %>%
  left_join(cluster_total, by = "cluster") %>%
  left_join(cluster_cond,  by = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(
    node_size = sqrt(n_cells) / max(sqrt(n_cells)) * NODE_MAX_SIZE,
    cluster   = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  arrange(as.integer(cluster))

# Discrete cluster colour palette (tab20-like)
clust_ids  <- sort(as.integer(unique(meta$cluster)))
clust_cols <- setNames(
  hue_pal()(length(clust_ids)),
  as.character(clust_ids)
)

cat("Nodes in layout:\n")
print(node_attrs[, c("cluster", "n_cells", "x", "y")])
```

```{r umap-overview, fig.width=7, fig.height=5.5}
ggplot(meta, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.6, shape = 16) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clust_cols) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = centroids,
    aes(x, y, label = cluster),
    colour = "black", fill = alpha("white", 0.7),
    size = 2.5, label.size = 0.2, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3),
                               ncol = 3, title = "Cluster")) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  labs(title = "HSC clusters (res 0.9)")
```

# 3 · Per-condition PAGA graphs

Each panel shows only cells from that condition (coloured) on a grey background of all cells.
Edge width ∝ per-condition PAGA connectivity; edges below `COND_THR` are hidden.

```{r cond-graph-helpers}
#' Build a tbl_graph positioned at UMAP centroids.
#' @param edge_df  data.frame with cluster_A, cluster_B, weight
#' @param node_df  data.frame with cluster, x, y, n_cells
make_graph <- function(edge_df, node_df) {
  # Keep only nodes that appear in edges + have positions
  used <- union(edge_df$cluster_A, edge_df$cluster_B)
  nodes <- node_df %>% filter(cluster %in% used) %>%
    mutate(.name = cluster)
  edges <- edge_df %>%
    filter(cluster_A %in% nodes$cluster,
           cluster_B %in% nodes$cluster)
  tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, directed = FALSE)
}

#' ggraph panel for one condition.
#' @param cond_name  "WT", "mCh-", or "mCh+"
#' @param weight_col  column in cond_edges to use as weight
#' @param edge_col    hex colour for edges
cond_panel <- function(cond_name, weight_col, edge_col) {
  cells_bg   <- meta[, c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")]
  cells_fg   <- meta %>% filter(condition == cond_name)

  edf <- cond_edges %>%
    transmute(cluster_A, cluster_B,
              weight = .data[[weight_col]]) %>%
    filter(weight >= COND_THR)

  g <- make_graph(edf, node_attrs)

  ggraph(g, layout = "manual",
         x = V(g)$x, y = V(g)$y) +
    # Grey background — all cells
    geom_point(data = cells_bg,
               aes(UMAP1, UMAP2), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               colour = "#cccccc", size = BG_SIZE, alpha = BG_ALPHA, shape = 16) +
    # Condition cells
    geom_point(data = cells_fg,
               aes(UMAP1, UMAP2), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               colour = edge_col, size = FG_SIZE, alpha = 0.5, shape = 16) +
    # PAGA edges
    geom_edge_link(aes(width = weight, alpha = weight),
                   colour = edge_col,
                   lineend = "round", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.4, EDGE_MAX_WIDTH)) +
    scale_edge_alpha(range = c(0.3, 0.9)) +
    # Nodes
    geom_node_point(aes(size = node_size),
                    fill = "white", colour = edge_col,
                    shape = 21, stroke = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_node_text(aes(label = cluster), size = 2.2, fontface = "bold",
                   colour = "black") +
    scale_size_identity() +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    labs(title = cond_name) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold",
                                    colour = edge_col, size = 13))
}
```

```{r plot-cond-panels, fig.width=15, fig.height=5.5}
p_wt  <- cond_panel("WT",    "wt",     COND_PAL["WT"])
p_neg <- cond_panel("mCh-",  "mchneg", COND_PAL["mCh-"])
p_pos <- cond_panel("mCh+",  "mchpos", COND_PAL["mCh+"])

p_wt + p_neg + p_pos +
  plot_annotation(title = "PAGA — per-condition connectivity (res 0.9)",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14,
                                                           face = "bold")))
```

# 4 · Combined graph — three conditions overlaid

Global PAGA graph drawn once; edge colour shows the dominant condition.
All three condition-edge sets are plotted as separate layers on the same coordinate system.

```{r combined-graph, fig.width=7, fig.height=5.5}
# Build per-condition edge layers (same node layout)
make_edge_layer <- function(weight_col, cond_col, thr = COND_THR) {
  cond_edges %>%
    transmute(cluster_A, cluster_B,
              weight = .data[[weight_col]],
              colour = cond_col) %>%
    filter(weight >= thr) %>%
    left_join(node_attrs %>% select(cluster, x, y),
              by = c("cluster_A" = "cluster")) %>%
    rename(x1 = x, y1 = y) %>%
    left_join(node_attrs %>% select(cluster, x, y),
              by = c("cluster_B" = "cluster")) %>%
    rename(x2 = x, y2 = y) %>%
    drop_na(x1, y1, x2, y2)
}

edges_wt  <- make_edge_layer("wt",     COND_PAL["WT"])
edges_neg <- make_edge_layer("mchneg", COND_PAL["mCh-"])
edges_pos <- make_edge_layer("mchpos", COND_PAL["mCh+"])

all_edges <- bind_rows(
  mutate(edges_wt,  condition = "WT"),
  mutate(edges_neg, condition = "mCh-"),
  mutate(edges_pos, condition = "mCh+")
) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = COND_ORDER))

# Slight jitter on overlapping edges so all three are visible
set.seed(42)
all_edges <- all_edges %>%
  mutate(
    jitter = (as.integer(condition) - 2) * 0.08,
    x1j = x1 + jitter * (y2 - y1) / sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2 + 1e-9),
    y1j = y1 - jitter * (x2 - x1) / sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2 + 1e-9),
    x2j = x2 + jitter * (y2 - y1) / sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2 + 1e-9),
    y2j = y2 - jitter * (x2 - x1) / sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2 + 1e-9)
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = meta[, c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")],
             aes(UMAP1, UMAP2), colour = "#cccccc",
             size = BG_SIZE, alpha = BG_ALPHA, shape = 16) +
  geom_segment(data = all_edges,
               aes(x = x1j, y = y1j, xend = x2j, yend = y2j,
                   colour = condition, linewidth = weight, alpha = weight),
               lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(data = node_attrs,
             aes(x, y, size = node_size),
             fill = "white", colour = "grey30",
             shape = 21, stroke = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = node_attrs,
            aes(x, y, label = cluster),
            size = 2.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COND_PAL, name = "Condition") +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.4, EDGE_MAX_WIDTH), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.25, 0.85), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_identity() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  labs(title = "PAGA — all conditions overlaid")
```

---

# 5 · Edge condition specificity

## 5.1 Dominant condition (categorical)

For each edge, the dominant condition is the one with the highest PAGA weight.
Edge width ∝ global connectivity; colour = dominant condition.
Specificity (opacity) = how much the dominant condition exceeds the mean:
`(max_w − mean_others) / max_w`.

```{r specificity-calc}
spec_edges <- cond_edges %>%
  filter(max_weight >= GLOBAL_THR) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    w_vec     = list(c(wt = wt, `mCh-` = mchneg, `mCh+` = mchpos)),
    dominant  = COND_ORDER[which.max(c(wt, mchneg, mchpos))],
    max_w     = max(wt, mchneg, mchpos),
    mean_oth  = (wt + mchneg + mchpos - max_w) / 2,
    specificity = (max_w - mean_oth) / (max_w + 1e-9)  # 0 = uniform, 1 = exclusive
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(dominant = factor(dominant, levels = COND_ORDER)) %>%
  left_join(node_attrs %>% select(cluster, x, y), by = c("cluster_A" = "cluster")) %>%
  rename(x1 = x, y1 = y) %>%
  left_join(node_attrs %>% select(cluster, x, y), by = c("cluster_B" = "cluster")) %>%
  rename(x2 = x, y2 = y) %>%
  drop_na(x1, y1, x2, y2)

cat(sprintf("Edges by dominant condition:\n"))
print(spec_edges %>% count(dominant) %>% arrange(dominant))
```

```{r plot-specificity-dominant, fig.width=7, fig.height=5.5}
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = meta[, c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")],
             aes(UMAP1, UMAP2), colour = "#cccccc",
             size = BG_SIZE, alpha = BG_ALPHA, shape = 16) +
  geom_segment(data = spec_edges,
               aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2,
                   colour = dominant,
                   linewidth = max_weight,
                   alpha = specificity),
               lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(data = node_attrs,
             aes(x, y, size = node_size),
             fill = "white", colour = "grey30",
             shape = 21, stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = node_attrs,
            aes(x, y, label = cluster),
            size = 2.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COND_PAL, name = "Dominant\ncondition") +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.4, EDGE_MAX_WIDTH),
                  name = "Connectivity") +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.15, 0.95),
              name = "Specificity",
              labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_size_identity() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  labs(title = "Edge dominant condition",
       subtitle = "Width = connectivity · Opacity = condition specificity")
```

## 5.2 Continuous specificity strip

Edges coloured by specificity score on a continuous diverging scale.
Low specificity (shared) → grey; high specificity (exclusive) → condition colour.

```{r plot-specificity-continuous, fig.width=15, fig.height=5.5}
# For each condition: show edges where that condition dominates,
# coloured by specificity (0 = shared across conditions, 1 = exclusive)
spec_panel <- function(cond_name, weight_col, cond_col) {
  df <- spec_edges %>%
    filter(dominant == cond_name,
           .data[[weight_col]] >= COND_THR)

  if (nrow(df) == 0)
    return(ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = paste(cond_name, "(no dominant edges)")))

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = meta[, c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")],
               aes(UMAP1, UMAP2), colour = "#cccccc",
               size = BG_SIZE, alpha = BG_ALPHA, shape = 16) +
    geom_segment(data = df,
                 aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2,
                     colour = specificity,
                     linewidth = .data[[weight_col]]),
                 alpha = 0.85, lineend = "round") +
    geom_point(data = node_attrs,
               aes(x, y, size = node_size),
               fill = "white", colour = "grey40",
               shape = 21, stroke = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = node_attrs,
              aes(x, y, label = cluster),
              size = 2.2, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_colour_gradient(low = "#cccccc", high = cond_col,
                          limits = c(0, 1), name = "Specificity",
                          labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_linewidth(range = c(0.4, EDGE_MAX_WIDTH), guide = "none") +
    scale_size_identity() +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
    labs(title = cond_name,
         subtitle = sprintf("dominant edges (n=%d)", nrow(df)))
}

spec_panel("WT",   "wt",     COND_PAL["WT"]) +
spec_panel("mCh-", "mchneg", COND_PAL["mCh-"]) +
spec_panel("mCh+", "mchpos", COND_PAL["mCh+"]) +
plot_annotation(
  title    = "Condition-specific edges",
  subtitle = "Colour = specificity (grey = shared, saturated = exclusive to condition)",
  theme    = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
)
```

# 6 · Specificity scatter — per-edge condition profile

One row per edge. Strips show WT / mCh− / mCh+ weight side by side,
sorted by dominant condition and specificity.

```{r specificity-scatter, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
spec_long <- spec_edges %>%
  select(cluster_A, cluster_B, dominant, specificity,
         wt, mchneg, mchpos, max_weight) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(wt, mchneg, mchpos),
               names_to  = "condition",
               values_to = "weight") %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(recode(condition,
                              wt = "WT", mchneg = "mCh-", mchpos = "mCh+"),
                       levels = COND_ORDER),
    edge_label = paste0(cluster_A, "–", cluster_B)
  )

# Order edges by dominant condition then descending specificity
edge_order <- spec_edges %>%
  arrange(dominant, desc(specificity)) %>%
  mutate(edge_label = paste0(cluster_A, "–", cluster_B)) %>%
  pull(edge_label)

spec_long <- spec_long %>%
  mutate(edge_label = factor(edge_label, levels = edge_order))

ggplot(spec_long, aes(weight, edge_label, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COND_PAL, name = "Condition") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  facet_grid(dominant ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(dominant = function(x) paste("Dominant:", x))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8)
  ) +
  labs(x = "PAGA connectivity", y = "Edge (cluster A – cluster B)",
       title = "Per-edge condition weight profile",
       subtitle = "Sorted by dominant condition and specificity")
```

# 7 · Connectivity heatmaps

```{r conn-heatmaps-helper}
# Build n_clusters × n_clusters matrix for one condition
# Includes only clusters present in node_attrs (not excluded)
all_clusters <- sort(as.integer(node_attrs$cluster))

cond_matrix <- function(weight_col) {
  mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(all_clusters), ncol = length(all_clusters),
                dimnames = list(all_clusters, all_clusters))
  rows <- cond_edges %>%
    filter(cluster_A %in% as.character(all_clusters),
           cluster_B %in% as.character(all_clusters))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    a <- as.character(rows$cluster_A[i])
    b <- as.character(rows$cluster_B[i])
    w <- rows[[weight_col]][i]
    mat[a, b] <- w
    mat[b, a] <- w
  }
  as.data.frame(mat) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster_from") %>%
    pivot_longer(-cluster_from, names_to = "cluster_to", values_to = "weight") %>%
    mutate(across(c(cluster_from, cluster_to), ~ factor(.x, levels = all_clusters)))
}

hm_wt  <- cond_matrix("wt")     %>% mutate(condition = "WT")
hm_neg <- cond_matrix("mchneg") %>% mutate(condition = "mCh-")
hm_pos <- cond_matrix("mchpos") %>% mutate(condition = "mCh+")
hm_all <- bind_rows(hm_wt, hm_neg, hm_pos) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = COND_ORDER))
```

```{r plot-heatmaps, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
ggplot(hm_all, aes(cluster_to, cluster_from, fill = weight)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#08519c",
                      limits = c(0, 1), name = "Connectivity") +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, ncol = 3) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.grid    = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Cluster",
       title = "PAGA connectivity matrices by condition")
```

## 7.1 Difference matrices

Positive = stronger in the first condition; negative = stronger in the second.

```{r diff-heatmaps, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
make_diff <- function(w_a, w_b, label) {
  cond_matrix(w_a) %>%
    rename(w_a = weight) %>%
    left_join(cond_matrix(w_b) %>% rename(w_b = weight),
              by = c("cluster_from", "cluster_to")) %>%
    mutate(diff = w_a - w_b, label = label)
}

diff_all <- bind_rows(
  make_diff("mchpos", "wt",     "mCh+ − WT"),
  make_diff("mchpos", "mchneg", "mCh+ − mCh−"),
  make_diff("mchneg", "wt",     "mCh− − WT")
) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c("mCh+ − WT", "mCh+ − mCh−", "mCh− − WT")))

vabs <- max(abs(diff_all$diff), na.rm = TRUE)
vabs <- min(round(vabs, 2), 1)

ggplot(diff_all, aes(cluster_to, cluster_from, fill = diff)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-vabs, vabs),
                       name = "Δ connectivity") +
  facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = 3) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.grid    = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Cluster",
       title = "PAGA connectivity differences",
       subtitle = sprintf("Colour scale ±%.2f", vabs))
```
